subject: general
question: The compound interest on a sum of Rs. 92670 at 15% per annum for 1 year when interest is compounded after every four months is :
solution:
**Given:**

The sum is Rs. 92670

Rate% = 15% per annum

Time = 12 months

**Formula used:**

The effective rate of interest for 3 years or 3 cycles = 3R + 3R²/100 + R³/10000

Where R = rate %

CI = Principal × (1 + R/100)ⁿ - Principal

Where CI = compound interest

n = number of years

**Calculation:**

Rate for 12 months = 15%

⇒ Rate for 4 months = 15/12 × 4 = 5%

Time = 1 year

There will be 3 cycles of 4 months in 1 year

The effective rate of interest for 1 year = 3× 5 + 3 × 5²/100 + 5³/10000

⇒ 15 + 0.75 + 0.0125 = 15.7625%

Compound interest = 92670 × 15.76251/100

⇒ 14607.10

**∴ The compound interest is Rs.14607.10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Principal = Rs. 92670

Rate for 4 months = 15/12 × 4 = 5%

Amount = 92670 × (1 + 5/100)³

⇒ Amount = 92670 × 105/100 × 105/100 × 105/100 = (9267 × 21 × 21 × 21)/800

⇒ 107277.109

Compound interest = Amount - Principal

⇒ 107277.109 - 92670 = Rs. 14607.10

∴ The compound interest is Rs.14607.10
